# sq-58 — Normalize or reject an unsorted or null ProfileOptions.IncludeValuesFor

The init path of ProfileOptions (promoted in the user guide by sq-49) stores the allow-list as given: the writer emits it in that order (DescriptorWriter.cs, includeValuesFor) and `required` does not stop `= null!`. The old positional constructor had the same hole, so this is not a regression, but a descriptor made from an unsorted list differs from one made through `Create`. Decide whether the profiler normalizes (sort, de-duplicate) or rejects, or documents it; a descriptor change here is a minor change to document.
